prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-realistic photorealistic candid paparazzi-style street photograph of a joyful clearly adult blonde woman captured mid-laugh on a bright sunny day. She looks slightly off-camera in a spontaneous unposed moment, radiating happiness and carefree energy. Her expression is lively and genuine, eyes softly squinting from laughter, natural smile showing subtle teeth, highly detailed facial features, realistic skin texture, visible pores, soft blush on cheeks, natural lips, and delicate highlights on her nose and cheekbones from direct sunlight. She wears a light-blue floral headscarf with delicate white and pastel flower patterns, loosely tied around her head and framing her face with blonde wisps escaping in the breeze. Her outfit includes a fitted white cropped T-shirt with bold clean black typography reading LONDON NEVER SUMMER across the chest, high-waisted medium-wash blue denim jeans, a tan leather belt with classic gold buckle, and a sleek gold wristwatch. Use natural daylight, warm sunlight, soft shadows, glowing rim light around hair and shoulders, a softly blurred urban street, handheld camera feel, slight motion realism, authentic paparazzi energy, natural color grading, realistic contrast, an 85mm lens look, crisp focus on the face, restrained HDR, and subtle film grain.
